verdict.rationale: Docusaurus ships a documented official CLI at docusaurus.io/docs/cli. It covers scaffolding (npx create-docusaurus), local preview with a dev server, production builds, docusaurus serve, and a versioning CLI command, so the core story is clearly delivered. missing for 10: evidence of agent-friendly CLI traits (machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive flags), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI workflows.
